user.title: Neumorphism
user.description: Provides the theme “Neumorphism” and adds all settings to the Theme section of your profile: colors, background, effect strength, light direction, surface, roundness, font and more. Afterwards select the theme “Neumorphism” in your profile.

init.title: Default for all users
init.description: Applies to all users who do not change the setting in their profile. Empty fields: theme default. Easier: “Use as default for everyone” in your profile.

data_description.strength: -100 to 100. Positive raised, 0 flat, negative inverted.
data_description.light_direction: Where the light comes from; shadows fall on the opposite side.
data_description.surface: Raised surfaces even, convex or concave.
data_description.contrast: High: stronger text, lines and shadows and a fine edge around every surface.
data_description.roundness: 0 to 200 percent of the usual roundness; 0 is square.
data_description.font: Rounded: Nunito, shipped with the integration.
data_description.sections: In section dashboards, the cards of each section in an inset well or on a raised plate.
data_description.animations: Buttons sink in when pressed, switches and selections glide.
data_description.glow: Devices that are on glow softly in their state color.
data_description.addons: Add-on interfaces and integration pages in the same design.

set_style.name: Set style
set_style.description: Sets settings of the Neumorphism theme for all users and devices until they are cleared with “Clear style”. Settings that are not given stay as they are.
